ideas.text: An AI pet translator that tells your cat she is disappointed in your personal brand.
A fantasy football copilot that drafts entirely on narrative arcs and revenge energy.
An AI wedding planner that quantifies how photogenic each relative's resentment will be.
A gardening app that identifies plants and roasts your soil choices.
An AI travel concierge that suggests destinations based on where your ex cannot afford to go.
A recipe generator that insists every dish can be elevated with truffle oil and unresolved trauma.
An AI baby-name engine trained exclusively on failed startups and Scandinavian furniture.
A knitting assistant that converts scarf patterns into blockchain metaphors.
An AI astrology app that matches your moon sign with an overpriced desk lamp.
A museum guide that summarizes every painting as someone processing a lot.
An AI fantasy author that generates dragon names already taken on Instagram.
A garage-sale arbitrage bot that values dusty lamps like pre-seed startups.
An AI roommate mediator that issues ceasefires for sink disputes.
A karaoke coach that recommends songs based on delusion rather than vocal range.
An AI dog-walking marketplace with surge pricing every time it drizzles.
An interior-design copilot that detects whether your apartment says taste or recent breakup.
An AI board-game assistant that explains the rules differently to maintain conflict.
A vacation planner that only recommends places where you can become insufferable afterwards.
An AI family historian that turns one ancestor's rumor into a prestige miniseries.
A sports bar app that uses facial recognition to predict who will yell at the TV first.
